constraints: Only the supplied evidence file may be used; do not assume other engine versions, renderers, or hardware.
No spec PASS criterion (§11 verdict lines, tic budgets, tolerances) may be weakened, moved, or redefined.
The engine has no timescale control and parallel instances hang; proposals must respect both.
Distinguish measured facts from new proposals; mark anything unverifiable PARTIAL/BLOCKED.

deliverables.description: Ranked time-saving measures with quantified effect, risks, and exact harness changes. Must preserve every §11 verdict.
Row per spec test (T1-T16 incl. args): budget, verdict line, where time goes, which measure applies, expected wall time.

purpose: Cut wall-clock testing time for the FRONTLINE44 milestone suite without losing any functionality.

acceptance.condition: Each ranked measure states expected seconds saved per run and per suite, what must change in the harness, and why no PASS criterion is affected.

requirements.requirement: Rank concrete time-saving measures with quantified effect and implementation steps.

acceptance.condition: Every spec test T1-T16 including all ARG variants appears with its budget, verdict line, time breakdown, applicable measures, and expected wall time; no test missing.

requirements.requirement: Cover the full test suite in a comprehensive evaluation matrix.

acceptance.condition: Plan explicitly rules on the supplied hypotheses H1-H4 (adopt, modify, or reject with reason) and adds any better ideas with the same rigor.

requirements.requirement: Assess hypotheses H1-H4 and propose anything strictly better.

in: Analyze the supplied timing evidence and test inventory.
Propose the most time-efficient testing approach preserving 100% functionality.
Specify a comprehensive per-test evaluation set with expected times.
out: Change game, engine, or spec files.
Weaken or redefine any PASS criterion.
Run the game or reproduce measurements.

sources.role: Measured timings, fixed constraints, full test inventory with tic budgets, mitigations already applied, and hypotheses H1-H4 to assess.

stop_condition: Deliver test-speed-plan.md and eval-matrix.md; mark gaps PARTIAL/BLOCKED with explicit limitations.
task: Propose the absolute most time-efficient way to run this fixed test suite, with a per-test evaluation set, changing nothing about what passing means.
title: Fastest functional testing approach for FRONTLINE44 suite
